card.name: Opening parenthesis in section cross-references
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis right after a section name inside a bracketed cross-reference such as [see Adverse Reactions (6)]. It also fires on a similar break inside a heading name like CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY.

modes.label: After Adverse Reactions
modes.description: The parenthesis that comes before section number 6 in a see-reference to Adverse Reactions.

modes.label: After Clinical Pharmacology
modes.description: The parenthesis before section number 12.x in a see-reference to Clinical Pharmacology.

card.plain: It marks the point in a label's "[see Section (number)]" reference where the section number is about to start.
